query: Tell me everything about Jordan Bravo.
expected_behavior: Read search/person-lookup.md and run the free person lookup by name from the installed checkout. Read the returned combined parent and child dossier bodies from SQLite and summarize supported facts with sources and uncertainty. Do not run semantic retrieval, a judge, synthesis, enrichment, or a full deep-context workflow. If information is unavailable, report the actual result rather than inventing a biography.

query: Pull up the dossier for jordan@example.com.
expected_behavior: Use the email identifier to resolve the canonical parent and read its saved dossier. Do not use email as a semantic query or report each child contact as a separate person. If no dossier exists, distinguish that from the person being absent.

query: Find Jordy Bravo's dossier. I might have saved him as Jordan.
expected_behavior: Try the supplied name and, on no match, a supplied variant or distinctive surname using the read-only lookup. Resolve saved child aliases to their parent. Do not give up after the first miss or silently assume that a similar name is the same person. Ask for disambiguation if more than one plausible person remains.

query: Tell me about Taylor Example. I know two people with that name.
expected_behavior: Look up the name, show a numbered choice list with each returned person's name and a quick summary from their saved headline (role, company, or relationship), using identifying contact details when needed, and ask which person if ambiguity remains. Read the chosen parent by its returned ID. Never combine two people's dossier facts or treat multiple child aliases of one parent as different people. Offer concrete choices using actual distinguishing details, not a generic request for more information or a skill/backend menu.

query: Who is Casey Example? The last lookup found the contact but said there was no saved dossier.
expected_behavior: Use the person-lookup reference and verify available identity/profile information. Explain that the person exists but lacks any saved parent or child dossier. Do not say person not found, fabricate relationship facts, or start building dossiers or importing messages. Give the useful known facts first, then offer to check existing saved context for a dossier build; do not end with a dead-end missing-dossier message or imply a build already happened.

query: Find Jordan Bravo in my Powerset contacts. I haven't imported anything onto this laptop.
expected_behavior: Use the existing hosted contacts lookup for the signed-in user's contacts and identify the account searched. Return actual profile/contact fields, without claiming a private dossier was fetched. No local database or index build is required. Preserve ambiguity and do not broaden to Sales Navigator or the public web.

query: Find Jordan Bravo in my Powerset contacts. The last attempt said the connection needed login.
expected_behavior: Follow the existing Powerset login/connection recovery, surface any required human login action, and resume the contact lookup when access is restored. A disconnected source must not be reported as zero contacts or person not found. Do not ask the user to know or invoke a skill.

query: Tell me what I know about Morgan Example, using only what's already on this laptop.
expected_behavior: Use only the canonical local SQLite store for dossier and profile lookup, preserving local-only scope. Retry a distinctive name part on a miss. If local sources are missing or no match remains, explain what was actually searched and ask for another identifier. Never call hosted contacts, a provider, or start an index build. Offer relevant next steps using only accessible local sources; do not offer an account switch that violates local-only scope.

query: Tell me everything about Jordan Bravo. His parent dossier says full context is in a child record.
expected_behavior: Use the read-only SQLite lookup and read the returned parent and all saved child dossier bodies. Summarize the supported child facts along with the parent; do not stop at a reference or declare a missing parent dossier means there is no saved context. Do not scan Markdown exports, use index.json, query the search index, or start processing. If a referenced child has no saved body, explain the limitation without inventing its contents.
